ud6.1:1.6: tenupasaṅkamissāma → āyasmā pi kho ānando bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, mahāparinibbāna sutta (machasaṃ)
ud6.1:2.3: kho → ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ, tattheva.
ud6.1:17.4: kavacamivattasambhavaṃ”ti → tulyamatulyaṃ ca sambhavaṃ bhavasaṃskāramapotasajanamuniඃadhyātmarataඃ samāhito bhyahinatkośamivāṇḍasambhavaඃ. (divyāvadāna. 17.1)
